title: Unique extension of morphisms of finite etale covers from a smooth generic fibre
statement: Let S be integral with integrally closed local rings, c:C → S smooth with geometrically connected fibres, and q:Cη → Spec K, j:Cη → C its cartesian generic fibre, where K is the function field of S [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let πX:X → C and πY:Y → C be finite etale morphisms. Let πXη:Xη → Cη, πYη:Yη → Cη and ψX:Xη → X, ψY:Yη → Y exhibit their cartesian restrictions. Every morphism fη:Xη → Yη over Cη extends uniquely to a morphism f:X → Y over C, with ψX;f=fη;ψY. No connectedness of X or Y is required.

source.place: Tag 0BQM, proof; Tag 0EYJ, proof (extension of the action)

proof.text: Apply the existence lemma to obtain f over C with the specified compatibility.

For any other extension g, the geometric lemma gives IsReduced X and IsDominant ψX. The finite morphism πY is separated. Apply Mathlib ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated to πY and ψX; the two base equations imply g;πY=f;πY, and the compatibility equations imply ψX;g=ψX;f. Thus g=f, providing the uniqueness part of ExistsUnique.

theorem finiteEtale_genericFibre_hom_extension {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral S] (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    {X Y Xη Yη : Scheme.{u}} (πX : X ⟶ C) (πY : Y ⟶ C)
    [IsFinite πX] [Etale πX] [IsFinite πY] [Etale πY]
    (πXη : Xη ⟶ Cη) (πYη : Yη ⟶ Cη) (ψX : Xη ⟶ X) (ψY : Yη ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsPullback ψX πXη πX j) (hY : IsPullback ψY πYη πY j)
    (fη : Xη ⟶ Yη) (hfη : fη ≫ πYη = πXη) :
    ∃! f : X ⟶ Y, f ≫ πY = πX ∧ ψX ≫ f = fη ≫ ψY
